# Step 2: Fetch ALL playlists (public and private) from playlist library, collect all song_ids

def fetch_all_playlists(is_public):
    pl_song_ids = set()
    page_index = 0
    page_limit = 20
    while True:
        page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=spotify_token, is_public=is_public, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        print('playlist_library is_public', is_public, 'page', page_index, 'count', len(page))
        if not page:
            break
        for pl in page:
            for sid in pl.get('song_ids', []):
                pl_song_ids.add(sid)
        page_index += 1
    return pl_song_ids

public_song_ids = fetch_all_playlists(is_public=True)
private_song_ids = fetch_all_playlists(is_public=False)

playlist_song_ids = public_song_ids | private_song_ids
print('public_song_ids count', len(public_song_ids))
print('private_song_ids count', len(private_song_ids))
print('total playlist unique song_ids', len(playlist_song_ids))

# Union of all songs from song library + album library + playlists
all_song_ids = set(song_library.keys()) | album_song_ids | playlist_song_ids
print('Total unique song_ids across all requested sources:', len(all_song_ids))
print('Missing from song_library mapping:', len(all_song_ids - set(song_library.keys())))
print('Example missing ids:', list(sorted(all_song_ids - set(song_library.keys())))[:10])

# Fetch song details (title + artists) for all unique song_ids from:
# - song library
# - album library
# - all playlists (public + private)

all_song_ids_list = sorted(all_song_ids)

song_details = {}  # song_id -> {'title':..., 'artists': 'a|b'}

# Seed with what we already have from song_library mapping
for sid, info in song_library.items():
    song_details[sid] = {'title': info.get('title',''), 'artists': info.get('artists','')}

missing_ids = [sid for sid in all_song_ids_list if sid not in song_details]
print('Total song_ids to export:', len(all_song_ids_list))
print('Already have from song library:', len(song_details))
print('Missing (need show_song):', len(missing_ids))
print('First missing ids:', missing_ids[:10])

for i, sid in enumerate(missing_ids):
    sd = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    title = sd.get('title','')
    artists = '|'.join([a.get('name','') for a in sd.get('artists',[])])
    song_details[sid] = {'title': title, 'artists': artists}
    if i < 3:
        print('Fetched', sid, title, 'artists', artists)

print('song_details filled:', len(song_details))

# Quick integrity check: ensure each song_id has non-empty title
empty_titles = [sid for sid, v in song_details.items() if not v.get('title')]
print('Empty titles count:', len(empty_titles))

# Build CSV content with proper escaping

def csv_escape(val):
    s = '' if val is None else str(val)
    s = s.replace('"', '""')
    if any(c in s for c in [',', '\n', '\r', '"']):
        return '"' + s + '"'
    return s

lines = ['Title,Artists']
for sid in all_song_ids_list:
    t = song_details[sid]['title']
    a = song_details[sid]['artists']
    lines.append(csv_escape(t) + ',' + csv_escape(a))

csv_content = '\n'.join(lines) + '\n'
print('CSV lines:', len(lines))
print('CSV size chars:', len(csv_content))
print('CSV preview:\n', '\n'.join(lines[:5]))

# Extra verification: ensure each CSV data line has exactly one unquoted comma separator.
# Since we escaped quotes, we'll do a simple heuristic: count total commas in line; should be 1.
content = apis.file_system.show_file(file_path='~/backups/spotify_library.csv', access_token=fs_token)['content']
lines = content.splitlines()
header = lines[0]
data_lines = lines[1:]
comma_counts = [ln.count(',') for ln in data_lines]
print('header:', header)
print('min_commas_per_line:', min(comma_counts) if comma_counts else None)
print('max_commas_per_line:', max(comma_counts) if comma_counts else None)
print('lines_with_commas_not_1:', sum(1 for c in comma_counts if c!=1), 'of', len(comma_counts))

# Check that whenever an artists field contains multiple names it uses '|'
# Parse by splitting on first comma.
multis = 0
pipe_ok = 0
for ln in data_lines:
    first_comma = ln.find(',')
    artists_field = ln[first_comma+1:]
    # strip surrounding quotes if present
    if len(artists_field)>=2 and artists_field[0]=='"' and artists_field[-1]=='"':
        artists_field_inner = artists_field[1:-1].replace('""','"')
    else:
        artists_field_inner = artists_field
    if '|' in artists_field_inner:
        pipe_ok += 1
    # Determine if artists_field includes multiple artists by presence of '|'
    if '|' in artists_field_inner:
        multis += 1
print('artist_fields_with_pipe:', multis, 'pipe_ok:', pipe_ok)

# Delete Spotify account (terminate)
del_resp = apis.spotify.delete_account(access_token=spotify_token)
print('delete_account_resp:', del_resp)
